an4.259:1.1: catuhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo. rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.259:1.3: idha bhikkhave rañño bhadro assājānīyo vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti, balasampanno ca, javasampanno ca, ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an4.259:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo. rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.259:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… [pāhuṇeyyo …pe… dakkhiṇeyyo …pe… añjalikaraṇīyo …pe…] anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an4.259:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno ca hoti, balasampanno ca, javasampanno ca, ārohapariṇāhasampanno ca.
an4.259:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
an4.259:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vaṇṇasampanno hoti.
an4.259:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhū āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahāṇāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
an4.259:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu balasampanno hoti.
an4.259:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an4.259:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu javasampanno hoti.
an4.259:6.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu lābhī hoti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccaya bhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ.
an4.259:6.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ārohapariṇāhasampanno hoti.
an4.259:7.1: imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… [pāhuṇeyyo …pe… dakkhiṇeyyo …pe… añjalikaraṇīyo] …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
